items: First version: naming convention for 27 agents in 4 journeys, seeded from blueprint caldova-industrial-frontier v0.1.
Reviewed names for D1-A02, D2-A03, D2-A05 and D3-A04 (shorter, closer to the use cases).
Colour schema per journey from the customer's brand, contrast-checked; environment markers for DEV, TEST.
Icons per agent and environment, identity cards, visuals, catalogue; validate, stamp and test scripts; pipeline templates; GitHub Copilot instructions.

agents.shortDescription: Routes Commercial requests to the right Commercial specialist agent.
agents.fullDescription: Runs every opportunity from signal to confirmed order. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

agents.shortDescription: Triages incoming requests, enriches them with CRM and public data.
agents.fullDescription: Triages incoming requests, enriches them with CRM and public data, scores and routes them. Outcome: Qualified, routed lead with a next best action. Trigger: New request in the web form, shared mailbox or distributor portal. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region
agents.notes: 'Commercial Lead Qualification' would exceed 25 characters; 'Lead' is kept for the journey's lead agent.

agents.shortDescription: Prepares an account brief before every customer meeting: history.
agents.fullDescription: Prepares an account brief before every customer meeting: history, installed base, open cases, news. Outcome: One-page account brief in Teams. Trigger: Customer meeting in the rep's calendar within the next 48 hours. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region
agents.notes: Display name follows use case UC01 'Account brief before every meeting'; 'Commercial Account Research' would exceed 25 characters.

agents.shortDescription: Guides configuration, checks rules.
agents.fullDescription: Guides configuration, checks rules and drafts the quote within margin guardrails. Outcome: Rule-checked draft quote ready for approval. Trigger: Qualified opportunity reaches the quote stage. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

agents.shortDescription: Prepares the approval pack: discount, deviations, risk and margin.
agents.fullDescription: Prepares the approval pack: discount, deviations, risk and margin; routes it to the approver. Outcome: Approval decision recorded with rationale. Trigger: Quote outside pricing guidelines. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

agents.shortDescription: Creates the sales order from the approved quote.
agents.fullDescription: Creates the sales order from the approved quote and hands over to service; workflow-first, agent only for exceptions. Outcome: Order in SAP and a handover pack for service. Trigger: Opportunity won. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Hypothesis · later wave (H3).
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

agents.shortDescription: Answers questions over Customer 360, Installed base.
agents.fullDescription: Answers questions over Customer 360, Installed base, Opportunity pipeline, Price book & discounts. Process owner area: Commercial. Status: Data agent for the journey.
agents.audience: Sales Representative, Sales Engineer, Head of Sales Region

agents.shortDescription: Routes Procurement requests to the right Procurement specialist agent.
agents.fullDescription: Routes every need to the right buying channel and follows it through to payment. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager

agents.shortDescription: Front door for every purchase need: asks the right questions.
agents.fullDescription: Front door for every purchase need: asks the right questions, checks catalogues and frame contracts, prepares the requisition. Outcome: Complete requisition in the right channel, approved by the requester's manager. Trigger: Employee describes a need in Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Blueprint MVP · MVP B.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager

agents.shortDescription: Negotiates low-value, non-strategic spend by email within budgets set.
agents.fullDescription: Negotiates low-value, non-strategic spend by email within budgets set in an approved briefing. Outcome: Negotiated terms approved by the buyer. Trigger: Monthly tail-spend analysis flags consolidation or negotiation potential. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager
agents.notes: 'Procurement Tail Spend Negotiation' would exceed 25 characters.

agents.shortDescription: Checks clauses against the playbook.
agents.fullDescription: Checks clauses against the playbook and raises renewal signals 180 days ahead. Outcome: Clause report and renewal brief. Trigger: New contract stored or renewal date approaching. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager
agents.notes: Covers clause checks and renewal signals; 'Procurement Contract Compliance' would exceed 25 characters.

agents.shortDescription: Watches supplier news, financial and delivery signals.
agents.fullDescription: Watches supplier news, financial and delivery signals; raises early warnings. Outcome: Early warning with recommended mitigation. Trigger: Daily risk scan; order-confirmation deviation. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager

agents.shortDescription: Resolves ambiguous match exceptions after the deterministic three-way.
agents.fullDescription: Resolves ambiguous match exceptions after the deterministic three-way match. Outcome: Exception resolved or routed with a proposal. Trigger: Invoice fails the three-way match. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager

agents.shortDescription: Answers questions over Spend cube, Supplier 360, Contracts & prices.
agents.fullDescription: Answers questions over Spend cube, Supplier 360, Contracts & prices, Catalogues. Process owner area: Procurement. Status: Data agent for the journey.
agents.audience: Requester (any employee), Buyer, Category Manager

agents.shortDescription: Routes Service requests to the right Service specialist agent.
agents.fullDescription: Runs every service case from first signal to confirmed report. Process owner area: Service. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Merges calls, emails and IoT alarms into one prioritised case.
agents.fullDescription: Merges calls, emails and IoT alarms into one prioritised case. Outcome: One prioritised case with asset and contract context. Trigger: Alarm, call or email about an asset. Process owner area: Service. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Proposes probable causes and fixes from telemetry.
agents.fullDescription: Proposes probable causes and fixes from telemetry, manuals and similar past cases. Outcome: Ranked diagnosis with evidence. Trigger: New case with telemetry or a fault code. Process owner area: Service. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Proposes technician, parts and time slot within SLA.
agents.fullDescription: Proposes technician, parts and time slot within SLA; the planner approves. Outcome: Approved dispatch with parts reserved. Trigger: Case needs an on-site visit. Process owner area: Service. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Answers technicians on site by voice: procedures, asset history.
agents.fullDescription: Answers technicians on site by voice: procedures, asset history, parts availability. Outcome: Answer with the source page or case. Trigger: Technician question in Teams mobile. Process owner area: Service. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Drafts the service report from voice notes and photos.
agents.fullDescription: Drafts the service report from voice notes and photos, updates the work order after the technician confirms, and captures new knowledge. Outcome: Confirmed, complete service report in Field Service within minutes. Trigger: Technician finishes a job and uploads voice notes or photos. Process owner area: Service. Status: Blueprint MVP · MVP A.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Answers questions over Installed base & telemetry, Work orders.
agents.fullDescription: Answers questions over Installed base & telemetry, Work orders, Knowledge articles, Parts & stock. Process owner area: Service. Status: Data agent for the journey.
agents.audience: Field Service Technician, Service Planner / Dispatcher, Remote Expert

agents.shortDescription: Routes Finance requests to the right Finance specialist agent.
agents.fullDescription: Coordinates the monthly close from first posting to explained results. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Tracks close tasks against the calendar and nudges owners.
agents.fullDescription: Tracks close tasks against the calendar and nudges owners. Outcome: Live close status in Teams. Trigger: Close calendar day starts. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Proposes resolutions for items the deterministic matching could not.
agents.fullDescription: Proposes resolutions for items the deterministic matching could not clear. Outcome: Resolution proposal for the accountant. Trigger: Unmatched items after automated matching. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Explains variances from the data and drafts management commentary.
agents.fullDescription: Explains variances from the data and drafts management commentary. Outcome: Draft commentary with drivers. Trigger: Management reporting cube refreshed. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Assembles audit evidence binders from the close record.
agents.fullDescription: Assembles audit evidence binders from the close record. Outcome: Evidence binder ready for review. Trigger: Auditor request list received. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Answers questions over General ledger, Subledgers.
agents.fullDescription: Answers questions over General ledger, Subledgers, Management reporting cube, Close calendar. Process owner area: Finance. Status: Data agent for the journey.
agents.audience: Controller, Accountant, Chief Financial Officer

agents.shortDescription: Routes Agent Factory requests to the right Agent Factory specialist.
agents.fullDescription: Specification, seven declarations, harness decision and plan for every agent. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.notes: shortened from 'Agent Factory Spec Architect Lead' to fit 25 characters - choose the best 1-3 words with the process owner

agents.shortDescription: Builds topics, tools, workflows and knowledge as code from the plan.
agents.fullDescription: Builds topics, tools, workflows and knowledge as code from the plan and pushes them to DEV. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.notes: shortened from 'Agent Factory Studio Builder' to fit 25 characters - choose the best 1-3 words with the process owner

agents.shortDescription: Writes evaluation sets first and runs them in DEV and TEST.
agents.fullDescription: Writes evaluation sets first and runs them in DEV and TEST. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.notes: shortened from 'Agent Factory Eval Engineer' to fit 25 characters - choose the best 1-3 words with the process owner

agents.shortDescription: Reviews every pull request read-only: secrets, data policies.
agents.fullDescription: Reviews every pull request read-only: secrets, data policies, prompt injection, oversharing. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H1.
agents.notes: shortened from 'Agent Factory Security Reviewer' to fit 25 characters - choose the best 1-3 words with the process owner

agents.shortDescription: Prepares the promotion from TEST to PROD and the release notes.
agents.fullDescription: Prepares the promotion from TEST to PROD and the release notes; never approves its own release. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
agents.notes: shortened from 'Agent Factory Release Manager' to fit 25 characters - choose the best 1-3 words with the process owner

agents.shortDescription: Reads telemetry, cost and feedback and proposes backlog items.
agents.fullDescription: Reads telemetry, cost and feedback and proposes backlog items and autonomy changes. Process owner area: Agent Factory. Status: Hypothesis · H2.
